description:
DeFi protocol treasury holdings -- how much a protocol holds in its own treasury and what tokens it owns. Use it when the user asks about protocol treasuries, DAO holdings or protocol-owned liquidity.

[Access: pay 0.01 USDC via x402 (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header) OR authenticate with an API key. An x402-capable client will auto-pay; API-key clients pay nothing per call.]
name: get_treasuries
